title: Hội An develops as an international port
summary: Hội An on the Thu Bồn River linked local trade with wider Asian and overseas networks. Its streets and timber buildings preserve a commercial town shaped by several cultural communities.

claims.text: Hội An on the Thu Bồn River linked local trade with wider Asian and overseas networks. Its streets and timber buildings preserve a commercial town shaped by several cultural communities.
Domestic buildings, markets and religious spaces make exchange visible beyond cargo alone. The city’s long trading period includes changing relationships rather than one fixed set of partners.
